prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A vibrant, minimalist scene set against a smooth, pastel pink background. In the right half of the composition, a precarious stack of colorful, irregularly shaped geometric blocks rises vertically, each block a different bright hue—red, blue, green, orange, yellow, and purple—creating a playful, almost chaotic sense of balance. The blocks are slightly askew, emphasizing instability and tension. To the left, bold white text in a rounded, friendly font reads "ANALYSIS," with a simple, hand-drawn white bracket connecting the word to the stack, suggesting a conceptual link. The lighting is soft and even, casting gentle shadows that enhance the three-dimensionality of the blocks without introducing harsh contrasts. The overall style is clean, modern, and slightly whimsical, with a focus on clarity and visual impact. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the entire stack and text in sharp focus, reinforcing the graphic, illustrative quality of the scene.
